Prevention: Use seedlings that are free of scales
Use recommended spacing and size of planting holes
Avoid movement of farm tools, animals, seedlings and fruits from infested areas to the orchard because they can spread the scales
Use recommended fertilizer rates and irrigation schedules for the mango orchard because healthy plants are less susceptible
Remove weeds and other plant residues from the orchard
Monitoring: Scout the orchard fortinightly and inspect the whole plant particularly leaves, branches, twigs and growing points
Look for soft bodied white scales (1.5-3 mm in diameter) on upper side of the leaves and twigs.
Lift the white transparent scale covering to check for live females, crawlers and eggs under the scales
The females white scale changes to a pink colour when eggs are laid under the scale
Infested leaves turn pale green to yellow and leaves and branches can eventually die
Check fruits for external feeding conspicuous pink lessions can be seen around the feeding sites
Direct Control: Prune to remove infested twigs, leaves and fruits and burn or burry more than 20cm deep
Remove unnecessary branches before flower setting and after harvesting of the fruit
Conserve natural enemies by not spraying during high peaks of natural enemies
Intercrop with sesame, soyabeans or haricot beans to improve the field diversity and to encourage natural enemies
Application of a liquid soap solution can reduce the problem.
Apply at a rate of 1-2 ml per 1 litre of water
Restrictions: When using a pesticide or botanical, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label
Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides of
Apply as a drench, 6g of product in 1 litre of water per tree.
Must only be applied to healthy, actively growing trees.
Must only be applied as a soil drench application if a micro or drip irrigation system is present and not under dry land conditions .
Toxic to bees do not apply when bees are active.
